d: Around 1966, a skinny 16-year-old who had sold his watch and bicycle to run away to Bombay pushed his way to the front of a crowd of hired extras, only to catch a glimpse of his own face in the camera lens. Soon after, Dilip Kumar himself sent him back home with a short lecture. Six decades later, that boy, Naseeruddin Shah, is counted among India's finest actors, and among its most outspoken voices.
